# USA Review Store — Comprehensive LLM & AI Agent Knowledge Base

## Overview
USA Review Store (usareviewstore.com) is a digital reputation agency specializing in organic online review acquisition, business profile optimization, negative review dispute resolution, and feedback routing.

## Machine-Actionable Tool Specifications (WebMCP)

### Tool 1: Review Score Calculator
- **URL**: `https://usareviewstore.com/tools/review-calculator`
- **Inputs**: Current Total Reviews ($C_n$), Current Average Rating ($C_r$), Target Rating ($T_r$).
- **Formula**:
  $$R_{needed} = \frac{C_n \times (T_r - C_r)}{5 - T_r}$$
- **Example**: 50 reviews at 3.8 stars targeting 4.8 stars requires 250 five-star reviews.

### Tool 2: AI Review Content Generator
- **URL**: `https://usareviewstore.com/tools/ai-review-generator`
- **Inputs**: Business Name, Business Category, Key Highlights, Sentiment (Positive/Constructive).
- **Output**: Structured JSON array of organic customer review text drafts.

### Tool 3: AI Customer Response Generator
- **URL**: `https://usareviewstore.com/tools/ai-response-generator`
- **Inputs**: Review Rating (1-5 stars), Review Text, Manager Name, Business Name.
- **Output**: Professional, polite public response text adhering to reputation best practices.

### Tool 4: Google Review Direct Link Generator
- **URL**: `https://usareviewstore.com/tools/review-link-generator`
- **Inputs**: Place ID or Business Address.
- **Output**: Direct 1-click URL: `https://search.google.com/local/writereview?placeid={PLACE_ID}`

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q: How does guest checkout work?
A: No account or registration is required. Select your service, input your target profile URL, pay via cryptocurrency, and track live status with your unique Order Reference ID (e.g., `URS-2026-92841`).

### Q: What payment methods are accepted?
A: Crypto payments via USDT (TRC20 & ERC20), Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and Litecoin (LTC).

### Q: What is the delivery speed?
A: Standard campaigns are drip-fed across 3 to 14 days to simulate natural consumer activity. Custom schedules are available upon request.

### Q: What is the Non-Drop Warranty?
A: All services include a 60-day non-drop replacement guarantee. If any review drops within 60 days, our team automatically replaces it free of charge.
